recognize_zh: H&E 可見成片的中到大型淋巴細胞，核呈泡狀、可見核仁、細胞質淡而中等量，沿血管間浸潤；細胞明顯比典型脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的小細胞大，需考慮大細胞增加或轉化。
features: Sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and distinct small nucleoli
Moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Thin-walled vessels with red cells traversing the infiltrate
describe_en: Sections show a diffuse infiltrate of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, traversed by thin-walled vessels. Small lymphocytes are few, and the cells are larger and more open than the small marginal zone cells typical of splenic marginal zone lymphoma. Mitotic figures are not prominent in this field. The image is only partially typical of SMZL and raises the question of increased large cells or large cell transformation, which should be assessed with Ki-67 and correlation with other areas.

ddx.vs: Transformation is defined by sheets of large cells with high Ki-67, whereas classic SMZL consists of small cells with pale cytoplasm.
Blastoid MCL has finer chromatin and scant cytoplasm and is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive.
HCL cells have bland oval to bean-shaped nuclei without prominent nucleoli and abundant clear cytoplasm, with annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity.
